description: Rezones 608 Broadway Avenue to B5B commercial.
Applies Broadway architectural controls to the site.
Allows new mixed-use development with commercial and residential.

chips.text: Aligns development regulations for Broadway commercial area properties.
Previous development's failure to proceed remains unexplained.
One resident expressed concern regarding slope stability in the area.

description: Rezones Delainey Road and Nazarali Lane land for residential development.
Changes zoning to townhouse and low/medium density multiple-unit dwellings.
Requires a raised median on Delainey Road for traffic safety.

chips.text: Administration clarified R2 zoning permits parks, Kohkom Park use unchanged.
One public comment requested clarification on the dwelling group change.

description: Welcomed Ellen Hunks as the newest Commission member.
Updated budget for 2026 Planning Conferences was provided.
Members advised to register for October SPPI Conference.

chips.text: Conference budget is within $7,000 for member attendance.
Public members of the MPC attend planning conferences.
